overall_goal: Fold chocolate chips into the dough

goals.description: Retrieve and weigh the chocolate chips
goals.rationale: The person gets the chocolate chips from the cupboard, opens the package, and measures them using the kitchen scale.

goals.description: Mix the chocolate chips into the dough
goals.rationale: The person pours the weighed chocolate chips into the main mixing bowl and thoroughly folds them into the dough using a fork.
